description:
Define the event handle returned by `event_at` and the phase-aware registration API. Today's `event_at(slot, handler)` registers a single handler at a flat slot. The new API needs:

- A 1-arg or 2-arg form that takes a phase tag (`:bubble` default for backward compat, `:capture` opt-in).
- A handle type that's opaque enough that the web backend can stringify it to a wire ref (`"fiber:slot"`) but the TUI backend can use it directly as a map key.
- Storage on the fiber for both phases (today event_handlers stores one map indexed by slot; needs to also distinguish phase).

Likely signatures:

    event_at(slot, handler, phase \ :bubble) :: handle
    Filament.Event.handle(fiber_id, slot_index) :: %Filament.Event.Handle{}

## Acceptance
- New tests assert phase distinguishability (capture handler at slot N is different from bubble handler at slot N).
- Existing `event_at(slot, handler)` calls continue to work (default phase = bubble preserves today's semantics).
title: Phase 3.1: phase-aware event handle + registration API
